notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that a major update is now live, bringing some highly requested features and improvements to the game.

First and foremost, Steam Achievements have officially been added! You can now unlock a variety of achievements as you play, giving you more goals to chase and adding a new layer of progression to your experience. Whether you're a completionist or just love collecting achievements, there’s something here for everyone.

We’ve also addressed several minor animation issues that some players encountered. Character movements are now smoother and transitions feel more natural, helping to enhance immersion and overall gameplay flow.

In addition, we’ve made small but impactful changes to the map. Certain areas have been adjusted for better balance and pacing, offering a more refined exploration experience without compromising the original feel of the game.

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback. It truly helps us improve and grow. Keep playing, keep exploring, and stay tuned for more exciting updates in the near future!

See you in the game!
